title: andropogon lepidus var. intonsus
intro: Andropogon lepidus var. intonsus, commonly known as East Indian sandalwood grass or desert broom grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. The health benefits of Andropogon lepidus var. intonsus include its potential to support immune function and reduce inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Andropogon lepidus var. intonsus include sesquiterpene compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
